posts.name: PeterCHayward
posts.cooked:
Maybe someone's already done this math before, what's the most amount of cards played/powers used possible in a single hero's turn? For example if Argent Adept can give himself an additional power use with his play, and then give someone like Unity a card play which lets her give someone else a power use etc...

Assume ideal hero layout, hands, plateau but no particular environment or villain. What's the most number of powers and plays that you can get in a turn?

posts.name: dpt
posts.cooked:
What if you just restrict to powers? That, at least, is a bounded amount.

EDIT: That is, how many powers can the hero team use during a single turn, given arbitrary set up? You can play as many cards as you want, but only power use counts. Since each instance of a power can be used at most once (almost always), there's an upper bound on the total. But maybe there are ways to do shenanigans like destroying cards with powers on them, then playing new instances of the same cards.
